variants.html:
Who
You, and one listener: here a Consulting Partner, at Operational depth.
What
The exact words where that listener would stop listening, and a version that keeps your points.
Where
This page, on your own claude.ai plan. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
When
Before you send the email, pitch or message.
Why
A message can be true and still lose the room. This shows where.

    Before you run

    Paste the message and pick who will hear it.

  2. During

    About 6 Claude messages

    Read, rewrite, then a blind reader and a fear reader check it.

    Your call

    Copy the version that lands, or keep yours.

A version that landsNot yet: it still makes them tune out at 3 places, adds something you did not say.
ARCS is decision intelligence infrastructure, and the return case comes first: it takes the judgment, pattern recognition and room-reading a person has built up, which is irreplaceable and their most valuable capability, and makes it legible, compounding and deployable. Traditional human capital frameworks try to extract a person's knowledge and commoditize it. That value cannot be extracted, so those frameworks miss it. ARCS inverts the approach: instead of harvesting the capability, it helps the person develop it into a structural advantage that builds on itself and can be put to work.
